summary: The self-contained proof establishes both assertions without mathematical errors or gaps. Completeness of the planar lattice support justifies the parity-midpoint argument and its bound U <= 12 w_max. The geometric-series argument handles large tilts, while the valid comparison for arbitrary fractional section endpoints and the concavity of log G give W <= 76 M_* for the remaining tilts. Empty or singleton sets of wide integer heights, singleton lattice support, truncated maxima, and tied maxima are covered. The unimodular prism chart preserves the entire original support and weights, including both residual boundaries. A heavy residual row has mass at least W/152, and a weighted median on its affine line belongs to the original support and captures at least half that row in every containing ambient closed halfspace. This yields the simultaneous original-height mass and restricted-depth bounds at one original center, with a width-zero band.
